column1: # Vendored PUC 5.4.9 suite files that mention the internal test library T.
# Neither arm has the PUC ltests hooks (ltests.c, -DLUA_USER_H='"ltests.h"').
# "run" keeps such a file in the corpus: its T uses are all inside
# `assert(not T or ...)`, `if T then ... end` or an early
# `if T == nil then ... return end`, so with T undefined those blocks are dead
# code in both arms and only the rest of the file is compared -- the T-guarded
# blocks are skipped, not the file. "skip" keeps the documented SKIP with the
# reason below. A file moves to "run" only once every failure it shows is
# classified: a defect in tests/known-bad.tsv, a difference in
# tests/known-different.tsv with its docs/DIFFERENCES.md entry, or a skip row.

column3: T-guarded itself, but it is the suite driver: it loads and runs every other suite file and prints PUC's own summary, so the harness would run the corpus twice without comparing one feature
uses T.testC unguarded from line 31: the file is a testC harness, nothing left to compare without the PUC test library
uses T.listk and T.listcode unguarded (lines 38, 91): the file inspects PUC's constant and code lists

T-guarded blocks only; runs to its end with T absent on both arches since the error-path __close handlers of a Lua pcall run from the VM (debug level 2 is pcall, coroutine.lua:238) and the yield return event fires at resume time (coroutine.lua:352/354)
no T use outside a guard; the C-call bound it needs exists (tests/d54/err_12_ccall_reentry.lua). The printed stack-overflow depths differ by implementation limit: rows in tests/known-different.tsv

T-guarded blocks only; stops at errors.lua:206/207 (string.sub/string.rep accept a float argument without an integer representation, the libparity branch), and at errors.lua:175/190/191 (_ENV and computed operands named differently, IMPL-DEFINED, the errnames rows) and errors.lua:646 (nesting depth, IMPL-DEFINED): those need known-different rows before the file can run
T-guarded blocks only; runs to its end with T absent on both arches, every mode PASS after the 5.4 __eq selection fix

T-guarded blocks only; the runner bounds the file at 10 s: GC1/GC2 wait for a finalizer of a table kept alive by a dead stack slot (lines 63/82/87/92), which is the documented dead-slot difference; mode A is XFAIL, the weak-value/finalizer, ephemeron and count differences are listed in tests/known-different.tsv
runs to its end with T absent on both arches; its single unguarded assertion (line 122) is a difference from PUC, listed in tests/known-different.tsv and docs/DIFFERENCES.md

T-guarded blocks only; runs to its end with T absent on both arches since the error-path __close handlers of a Lua pcall run from the VM: they see pcall at level 2 (locals.lua:463) and can yield (locals.lua:955-980)

T-guarded blocks only; runs to its end with T absent on both arches after the format and table.concat fixes: mode A is XFAIL only on the %p identity of two long strings (line 194, the FORK string-interning row), B and R PASS
